design_tone: Timeless, romantic, luxurious yet minimal and warm. Inspired by high-end editorial wedding albums with ivory/cream surfaces, refined gold foil accents, bespoke serif headings, and crystal clear photo presentation.

entry_surfaces./: editorial wedding portal — warm cream hero with romantic photography banner & couple stories, leading directly into an asymmetric client wedding showcase grid with search & filter pills
entry_surfaces./gallery/:clientId: immersive wedding gallery — high-impact couple header with date/venue/total count, Google Drive sync status pill, masonry photo wall with filter tabs, batch download link, and full-screen luxury lightbox
entry_surfaces./admin: protected management console — elegant PIN auth entry card, transitioning to client manager dashboard with Drive URL validator, cover image picker, photo sync trigger, and client metrics

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_rules: All text must pass 4.5:1 contrast against surface backgrounds. Lightbox overlay uses #0C0A09 with bright white controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Template: farm-ts (FastAPI backend at 8001 + React 19 / Vite frontend at 3000 with Tailwind v4).

Font configuration in frontend/src/index.css: import '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display' and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans'. Map --font-heading to 'Playfair Display Variable' and --font-sans to 'DM Sans Variable'.

Google Drive Integration: Support public Google Drive folder links (e.g., https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/XYZ). Parse folder ID automatically in the backend. When configured without Google Cloud API credentials, fallback gracefully to a realistic simulated Drive photo scraper/resolver that returns curated wedding photos mapped to the folder ID, with realistic filenames (e.g., IMG_2024_01.JPG) and metadata.
Guest Experience: ZERO LOGIN required for guests visiting homepage or client gallery routes.

Admin Experience: Protected by a clean PIN gate (default '1234' with option to change). Once unlocked, admin can Add, Edit, Delete clients, change cover photos, update Drive links, and click 'Sinkronisasi Foto Sekarang'.

Indonesian UI Language: Use warm and polite Indonesian wedding phrasing ('Galeri Foto Pernikahan', 'Momen Bahagia', 'Buka Galeri Foto', 'Tanggal Acara', 'Lokasi Acara', 'Sinkronisasi Drive', 'Buka di Google Drive', 'Unduh Foto', 'Kelola Klien Wedding', 'Masukkan PIN Admin').
Lightbox: Full keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Escape), smooth animations, full-screen view, and download capability.

Seed Initial Data: Create /app/backend/seed.py with at least 6 rich client wedding galleries with real wedding photos from image_urls, varied venues across Indonesia (Bali, Jakarta, Bandung, Magelang), and run it so preview is instantly populated.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_standard: Top 1% luxury wedding editorial aesthetic. Soft ivory backgrounds, gold borders, elegant typography.
anti_patterns: Do NOT use default stark blue buttons or generic tech gradients.
Do NOT use Inter for headers; use Playfair Display.
Do NOT use raw HTML selects or unstyled date inputs; use Shadcn components.
Do NOT center-align the entire app container; use asymmetric luxury editorial grid layouts.
